$comment: Historical deployment-config example retained for reference. The current public release builder does not read this file. Server operators configure their server env; pilots configure PluginData/settings.cfg.

backend.$comment: Public origin where the backend API lives, with no trailing slash.
backend.$comment_apiPath: Path the backend mounts the v1 API at. Default is /v1.

web.$comment: Public origin where the SPA lives. May equal backend.origin for single-origin deployments.

livekit.$comment: WebSocket URL of your LiveKit Cloud project. Used only as documentation here; backend reads it from its own env.

session.$comment: Historical default channel example. Pilots configure their runtime settings independently of public release builds.
